transport_code.artifact_scope: Retained original Parade driver copies and INF files; no live calls, installation or current controller state read.

inf_routing.meaning: The retained INF files assign the08/18 identities to PRHidDrv and the listed companion identities to PRSpbDrv. These are package bindings, not current hardware-state measurements.

hid_get_feature.operation: Builds the response from driver-context version/status fields and completes the VHF operation. The reviewed body does not request a live connection-mode or branch-marker read.
hid_get_feature.existing_result: This cached-reply property was already known; it is reused here to qualify the newly identified mode-observation question.

hid_output.report25: Offer processing: may initialize SPB targets, compare firmware metadata and prepare update state. It is not a newly identified generic register-read report.
hid_output.report20: Payload handling can call firmware programming2d88, then firmware dump2cc0 for readback/verification. A name containing dump does not qualify passive runtime RAM/status access.
hid_output.limit: Only these original callback branches were reviewed; this is not an exhaustive proof that no other installed interface can expose status.

spb_read_route.operation: The initialization helper builds a RESOURCE_HUB path from a saved connection ID. The read helper constructs a write/read transfer sequence and submits it through the saved request/target. Caller buffers supply transfer data and lengths; this reviewed path does not select a new slave address from the register byte.
spb_read_route.limit: The fixed connection still needs the correct target, power/access prerequisites and register/page semantics. A read of register2 on the version endpoint is not independently qualified as the firmware mode byte2.

transport_code.mode_observer_status: No reviewed existing path is qualified to read the candidate connection bytes, interrupt gate or internal branch marker while preserving the failed attachment state.
missing: A proven mapping from the desired firmware byte to an accessible bus register/page.
A matching endpoint and resource ownership path for that register.
Read side effects and power/reset requirements, including whether the interface remains available during the failed pairing.
transport_code.already_failed_read: The earlier version read failed without returned data. No retry, changed endpoint, HID output, reset or driver rebind was performed.

windows_reference.summary: Windows assigns a connection ID to ACPI-supplied bus/controller/address/clock settings. A peripheral driver opens that connection through the resource hub. Ordinary user applications cannot open an SPB logical connection directly.
windows_reference.scope: Windows architecture reference, not a test of these devices or proof of the firmware register alias.

useful_path_audit.read_route: Current code qualification does not produce a passive mode observer. Reusing a named SPB read alone is insufficient because its target is fixed and the desired alias is unknown.
useful_path_audit.reference_lookup: Two targeted primary-source searches returned the existing Infineon Host SDK guide but no qualified PS8830 implementation source. No exhaustive source-availability claim follows.
useful_path_audit.remaining_specific_path: Inspect the already identified official ASUS service-guide board pages for a readable board revision and actual component/package labels around the USB-C path; compare variants explicitly. Then follow a concrete manufacturer source-distribution link only if it exposes the PS8830 interface implementation. Do not repeat unnamed-register or EC scans.
useful_path_audit.stop_rule: After this finite source/board qualification, if no new observable or interface becomes identifiable, disable recurring work and report the missing controller-state observation rather than consuming the remaining allowance.

quality.first_hash_literal_error: An incorrectly transcribed expected hash stopped the private script before any public output or model mutation. The original failed script is preserved; the corrected expected hash matches the pinned original binary.
quality.context_fragments: Mid-instruction context starts were excluded; claims use exact RVA/file mappings and checked byte spans.
